messages.content: "請問你能幫我找到藝術家文森·梵谷在蘇富比拍賣平台上作品名為「星夜」的價格，然後再去查詢愛德華·孟克在佳士得拍賣平台上作品名為「吶喊」的價格嗎？之後，我想在紐約公共圖書館搜尋哈波·李的作品名為「梅岡城故事」的書籍，然後在大英圖書館尋找喬治·奧威爾的作品名為「1984」的書籍。"

Platform: 蘇富比 -> Sotheby's.

Second call art_auction_fetch_artwork_price with artwork_name="吶喊" (The Scream), artist=爱德华·孟克 (Edvard Munch). Platform: 佳士得 -> Christie’s.

Third call library_search_book for 哈波·李 (maybe "Ha Po Li") works named "梅岡城故事" (Mekong City Story?) Author: 哈波·李. Platform: 紐約公共圖書館 (NYPL). So set platform param accordingly.

Fourth call library_search_book for 喬治·奧威爾 (George Orwell) work titled "1984" at 大英圖書館 (British Library). Provide platform param accordingly.

Thus produce four calls sequentially. We can do them one after another. Probably best to output each result separately. We'll make separate calls using the defined functions. Let's proceed.
